تبتسرن (form VIII)
# تَبْتَسِرْنَ (tabtasirna) /tab.ta.sir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# تُبْتَسَرْنَ (tubtasarna) /tub.ta.sar.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
